tools.name: property-official_uk-hpi-lookup
tools.description: Return official UK HPI average price, index and change figures for a geography and month from the vendored HM Land Registry full file. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-official/uk-hpi-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-official_epa-radon-zone-lookup
tools.description: Return the EPA Map of Radon Zones zone (1–3) for a US county from the vendored EPA spreadsheet. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-official/epa-radon-zone-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-official_hud-fmr-lookup
tools.description: Return HUD FY2027 Fair Market Rents for a county/town FIPS or HUD area, or Small Area FMRs for a ZIP, from vendored HUD files. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-official/hud-fmr-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-official_ofgem-price-cap-lookup
tools.description: Return the Ofgem GB domestic energy price cap for a region, fuel, meter and payment method for the vendored charge restriction period. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-official/ofgem-price-cap-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
